name: Reddit

profile.summary: Reddit, Inc. operates a digital community in the United States and internationally. The company's platform enables user to engage in conversations, explore passions, research new hobbies, exchange goods and services, create new communities and experiences, share laughs, and find belonging. It also organizes communities based on specific interests that enable users to engage in conversations by sharing experiences, submitting links, uploading images and videos, and replying to one another. Reddit, Inc. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

news.title: A Mid-40s Tech Worker’s $882,000 of Deferred Pay Would Arrive Over Five Years. Each Year Could Rule Out an ACA Credit
news.summary: Key TakeawaysA married Reddit poster in their mid-40s who is weighing a big-tech buyout has $882,000 of deferred pay due over about five years, or $176,400 a year if it’s paid evenly. Marketplace coverage gets the Premium Tax Credit only if household income is no more than 400% of the federal poverty line, and that cap applies again for tax years after 2025.

news.title: 2 Retirees in Their Mid-70s Want $500,000 From Their IRA in an Annuity. Cashed Out, It Could Raise Each Medicare Premium $446.30 a Month
news.summary: Key TakeawaysA poster in Reddit’s r/personalfinance says their in-laws are in their mid-70s and want to move $500,000 of a roughly $800,000 IRA into an annuity. If the $500,000 comes out of the IRA to buy the annuity, all of it is taxed as income that year: just over $101,500 in federal tax, even if it’s their only income.
